Remark
[Li--Schoen local Poincaré estimate]

Source: petersen:page-0324, petersen:page-0325 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-poincare-sobolev 1. ch7:7.5.17Let $(M,g)$ be complete with $\Ric \ge -(n-1)k^2$, $k\ge 0$; $p\in M$; $R>0$ with $\partial B(p,2R)\ne \emptyset $; $q\in \partial B(p,2R)$; $r(x)=|xq|$.

  1. Show $\Delta r\le (n-1)(R^{-1}+k)$ on $B(p,R)$.

  2. Let $f(x)=a\exp (-ar(x))$, $a>0$. Show $\Delta f\ge a\exp (-3aR)\big(a-(n-1)(R^{-1}+k)\big)$.

  3. Let $u\ge 0$ be smooth with compact support in $B(p,R)$, and choose $a=n(R^{-1}+k)$. Using $\int _{B(p,R)}u\, \Delta f\, \vol =-\int _{B(p,R)}g(du,df)\, \vol $, show $\int _{B(p,R)}u\, \vol \le C\int _{B(p,R)}|du|\, \vol $, where $C=\dfrac {R}{1+kR}\exp \big(2n(1+kR)\big)$.

  4. Extend the inequality of (3) to all smooth $u$ with compact support in $B(p,R)$.

  5. For $s\ge 1$ and $u$ with compact support in $B(p,R)$, show $\int _{B(p,R)}|u|^s\, \vol \le (sC)^s\int _{B(p,R)}|du|\, \vol $.
